dataset: Prompts shown by the authors (set not stated)

dataset: Long complex prompts shown by the authors (set not stated)
succeeds: It draws the main objects of long prompts in a coherent scene.
fails: It drops or replaces listed details, such as books, the medal, the toothbrush, the floral pattern and the scooter colour.
on_which: cozy room; red bell pepper and medal; dimly lit room; balloon and scooter; handbag and avocado; rose on lace napkin
failure_line: Long prompts lose details: no medal or books, a real car replaces the magazine picture, handbag has no flowers

dataset: Long complex prompts shown by the authors (set not stated)

on_which: red bell pepper and medal; rose on lace napkin
failure_line: Adds unrequested objects on long prompts: a gold trophy beside the medal, white roses behind the red rose
